summary: Practise data definitions, quality checks, metadata and issue resolution in a five-day course. Explore the outline and find your fit.
lede: Data steward training helps non-technical professionals coordinate data definitions, quality checks and issue follow-up. It is suited to stewards, business data owners and governance coordinators working between data users and technical custodians, often without control of source systems. Participants practise building glossary and metadata records, assessing fitness for use, routing data issues and documenting access guidance so users can judge whether data suits a decision.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for intermediate-level professionals who coordinate data meaning, documentation, quality or use in a business area. It suits roles that translate between data owners, users and technical custodians, especially when accountability exceeds direct authority over source systems.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with business data, records or reporting in your role is expected. No programming is required.
